Document reranking request routed through the proxy

```rust title="Rust"
use liter_llm::LlmClient;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let req_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"documents":["Deep learning is a subset of machine learning using neural networks.","The stock market closed higher today."],"model":"rerank-v3.5","query":"What is deep learning?"}"#).unwrap();
    let req = serde_json::from_value(req_json).unwrap();
    let client = liter_llm::create_client(std::env::var("API_KEY").expect("API_KEY must be set"), None, None, None, None).unwrap();
    let result = client.rerank(req).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.results);
    println!("{:?}", result.results[0].relevance_score);
}
```
